text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Boy howdy—you struck gold! And ya
looked so
cool runnin' the controls!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really? You mean there's cake in
there too?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, since you're such a pro at this,
next time be
sure to grab some cake too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You made today really special, so thank
ya! I
won't ever forget it!
